data.body:
Landed. Gerrit change 3114 patchset 3 (1c03961ec1f4d6226f881e625f613c283a86f028) got LLM-Review +1 at 19:58 PDT and Verified +1 at 20:17 PDT (run https://github.com/navapbc/rebar/actions/runs/40261261174), with 0 unresolved comments. It was submitted at 20:18 PDT via `scripts/gerrit_safe_submit.py 3114 --revision 1c03961ec1f4d6226f881e625f613c283a86f028` (rc 0). Gerrit shows status MERGED, and `git fetch gerrit main` gives tip 1c03961ec1f, parent 35ca10e501b.

PS3 had 2 LLM-Review advisories, both non-blocking and resolved. (a) The nested walker has no committed positive-case test; its red proof is the 11-form transcript above, not a test in the tree. (b) The ratchet tests assert the TOML shape and do not run `ruff check` (standing since PS2). Neither is fixed here.

Acceptance criteria, checked on merged main in a worktree at 1c03961ec1f (20:18 PDT; rebar imported from that worktree's src):
1. `ruff check --no-cache --select TID251,TID253 src tests scripts` -> All checks passed! (exit 0).
2. The RED-proof transcripts are in the comment above. `ls tests/unit/test_e10_red_tid251.py src/rebar/_e10_red.py` -> No such file or directory (both), and `git ls-files | grep -c _e10_red` -> 0.
3. `pytest -q tests/unit/test_ruff_ratchet.py` -> 19 passed. Collected: test_ruff_select_enables_the_two_tidy_import_bans, test_the_banned_module_level_stacks_are_exactly_the_named_ones, test_the_tests_package_stays_banned_with_its_reason, test_tid253_is_exempt_only_for_tests_scripts_and_the_engine_payload.
4. `git grep -n -w tomllib tests/unit/test_core_optionality.py` -> :24 `import tomllib`, :32 `tomllib.loads((Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2] / "pyproject.toml")...` feeding `_HEAVY`.
5. `pytest --collect-only -q tests/unit/test_tests_import_convention.py tests/unit/test_core_optionality.py` -> 5 tests collected (parent 35ca10e501b: 6, so 1 fewer). test_no_core_module_imports_heavy_stack_at_module_scope is absent and test_no_core_module_imports_heavy_stack_nested_at_module_scope collects. `_OPTIONALITY_SUITE_ITEM_COUNT = 10` (test_ci_workflow_parity.py:654). `pytest -q tests/unit/test_ci_workflow_parity.py tests/unit/test_core_optionality.py tests/unit/test_tests_import_convention.py` -> 38 passed, 2 skipped.
6. `python scripts/check_mechanism_delta.py --check` -> exit 0, `active=651 new=25 increased=0 stale=0`, output byte-identical to the parent 35ca10e501b run.
7. make verify ran 18:55 to 19:47 PDT on 1c03961ec1f, the exact merged commit: 17 failed, 19732 passed, 105 skipped. All 17 are the known arm64 pandoc failures (frenzied-snively-llama): 13 test_wiki_render.py, 3 test_rich_text_cutover.py, 1 diffing/test_diff_comments_cutover_neutral.py. 0 failures elsewhere and 0 `^ERROR tests` lines. It was not re-run after merge, because merged main is that same commit.
